table.title: Table
table.pauseFailed: Couldn't change the AI DM's pause state.
table.emptyHint: Type an action below to begin the scene.
table.rememberTranscript: Remember this transcript on this device
table.rememberTranscriptHelp: Off by default. The table's history lives on the server and reloads with the page, so keeping a copy here only makes it paint sooner — and that copy records what everyone said and what you asked. Leave it off on a shared device. Turning it off erases the stored copy; so does signing out.
table.composerPlaceholderCombat: Combat is live — describe your action…
table.composerLockedHuman: A human has taken the DM seat.
table.composerLockedAwaiting: Waiting on the rest of the table…
table.composerUnlocked: Composer unlocked. You can send an action.
table.sceneFieldHelp: Optional. Updates the table scene when you send an action.
table.composerHelp: Describe what your character does. Ctrl or ⌘+Enter to send.
table.viewerHint: You're watching as a viewer — only players can act.
table.systemTakeover: A human took over the DM seat.
table.offHint: No AI is running this table. The DM can switch on Driver mode (the AI acts directly as the DM) or Co-DM mode (the AI only proposes) in settings.
table.coDmHint: In Co-DM mode the AI only proposes — every draft waits for a human DM to approve, and nothing changes until then. There's no live table to play at. Switch to Driver mode to let the AI hold the DM seat and act directly.

grounding.title: AI claims to check
grounding.hint: The AI stated something as fact that the server could not trace to a source it actually read this turn. The narration is unchanged — this is a label, not a deletion.
grounding.dmOnlySource: Source visible to the DM only
grounding.correctPlaceholder: What is actually true? The AI is told this from the next turn on.

reason.false_application_claim: claimed a change was applied or approved
